issue4_items.title: Y08/Y09 SIGHASH_SINGLE overflow constant is wrong.
issue4_items.description: **Y08/Y09 SIGHASH_SINGLE overflow constant is wrong.** `Property/Y08/SighashLegacyProps.lean:99` defines `one256` as 32×`0x01`, but `Bitcoin.SigHash.singleOverflowOneB` is `0x01` followed by 31 zero bytes. The `b00`–`b04`/`d11` rows at `:442-466,831,1417` fail under `native_decide` (reproduced with `lake env lean`). Same mismatch at `Property/Y09/Property.lean:4401`. **Confirmed.**
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: BIP113 median uses lower median.
issue4_items.description: **BIP113 median uses lower median.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Pow.lean:236` uses `(n-1)/2`; Core `chain.h:233-244` uses `n/2` (upper for even counts). Update `medianTimePast`, `Bip/B07/Bip113MTP.lean` fixtures, and the `mtp_even_count_lower_median` expectations.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: BIP141 `castToBool` ignores negative zero.
issue4_items.description: **BIP141 `castToBool` ignores negative zero.** `Bip/B08/Bip141Defs.lean:54` uses `bytes.any (· != 0)`; Core treats `[0x00,0x80]` as false. Port Core's loop or reuse `Bitcoin.Numeric.castToBool`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `findAndDelete` corrupts scripts after any match.
issue4_items.description: **`findAndDelete` corrupts scripts after any match.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Interpreter/Defs.lean:548-564`: `fdLastPc2` returns the pre-match `pc2`, so the final `script.extract pc2 script.size` re-appends a suffix. `AF/PDW59/PDW59d.lean` discloses only the whole-tail case. Fix `fdLastPc2` to return the post-match `pc'`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: CVE-2012-2459 detector flags unaligned duplicates.
issue4_items.description: **CVE-2012-2459 detector flags unaligned duplicates.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Connect.lean:220-223` checks every adjacent pair; Core checks only pair-aligned `hashes[2i]==hashes[2i+1]`, so `[A,B,B]` is over-rejected. Update `merkleMutationFree` and the PDW12/PDW53 characterizations.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Witness commitment uses a zero reserved value.
issue4_items.description: **Witness commitment uses a zero reserved value.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Merkle.lean:187-195` hashes `zeroBytes 32`, not the coinbase witness reserved value. `witnessCommitmentOkReserved` exists in `AF/PDW13/WitnessCommitmentReserved.lean` but is orphaned; `commitmentGate` still uses the old definition. Wire the corrected definition through and re-prove BLK-017/SWT-030/PDW58B.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `validateBlock` omits the BIP30 gate.
issue4_items.description: **`validateBlock` omits the BIP30 gate.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Block.lean:382` calls `applyTxs` without `bip30BlockCollision`/`bip30Enforced`; `applyBlockL` does include it. Add the gate or route through `applyBlockL`, then update `CapstoneComposePipeline`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Taproot commitment is program-blind.
issue4_items.description: **Taproot commitment is program-blind.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Crypto/Taproot/Verify.lean:89-90` drops `program`; `OutputKey.outputKeyOk` checks only parity. Add Core's `q == program` / `CheckTapTweak` check and a wrong-program negative test; update `Audit/Z29`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Z21 EVAL_FALSE tests are false.
issue4_items.description: **Z21 EVAL_FALSE tests are false.** `Audit/Z21/Audit.lean:174,182` use `evalScriptBytes`, which never applies final-stack truthiness. Use `verifyScriptFull`/`executeWitnessScript`, and fix `"018000"` to `"028000"` if a two-byte push is intended.
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: `native_decide` in a non-Test module.
issue4_items.description: **`native_decide` in a non-Test module.** `Property/Y03/Property.lean:326-522` has 72 `native_decide` proofs, contradicting the header's kernel-`decide` claim. Convert to `decide` or move to a Test/experiment module.
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: Wallet selection determinism is tautological.
issue4_items.description: **Wallet selection determinism is tautological.** `Wallet/Spend/Selection.lean:115-135`: `largestFirst_deterministic`, `smallestFit_deterministic`, and `runSelection_deterministic` are all `f x = f x`. Replace with a real specification or remove.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Wallet hash-lock acceptance is vacuous.
issue4_items.description: **Wallet hash-lock acceptance is vacuous.** `Wallet/Miniscript/Interp.lean:1233`: `hproduce` requires `bytes [0,0,0,0]`, but the dissatisfaction is 32 zero bytes, so no hash fragment can satisfy it. Use `bytes (List.replicate 32 0)`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Merkle 64-shape matrix omits n=64.
issue4_items.description: **Merkle 64-shape matrix omits n=64.** `Theorems/Exhaust/MerkleShapes64.lean:147` iterates `List.range 64` (0..63), while `expectedRoot` covers 1..64. Iterate `k+1` or otherwise include n=64.
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: `blockWeight_witness_discount` has the hypothesis reversed.
issue4_items.description: **`blockWeight_witness_discount` has the hypothesis reversed.** `AF/PDW51/PDW51.lean:103` assumes `totalSize ≤ strippedSize`; witness-bearing blocks have `stripped ≤ total`. State `4*stripped + (total - stripped)` instead.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: SmallCurve interface is uninhabited.
issue4_items.description: **SmallCurve interface is uninhabited.** `SmallCurve/TweakCorSmall.lean:235`: `mulP_noneE` quantifies all `Nat k`, but `mulP'` only uses 16 bits. Restrict to `k < 2^16` or extend `mulP'`; otherwise the main theorems are vacuous.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `PubKeyCor` has a non-Lean placeholder and missing U2 results.
issue4_items.description: **`PubKeyCor` has a non-Lean placeholder and missing U2 results.** `EcdsaDeep/PubKeyCor.lean:192` contains `Bool.eq_true mp_eq??`; `:128` is malformed; the header's U2 declarations do not exist. Fix U1, then either add U2 or remove the claims.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: O07 hash-op examples are false.
issue4_items.description: **O07 hash-op examples are false.** `Theorems/Ops/O07.lean:415-442` expects the hashed element to remain on the stack, while `opHash_effect` pops it. This is in a disclosed failing module, but the statements themselves are wrong.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `FuelStability` lacks its advertised results.
issue4_items.description: **`FuelStability` lacks its advertised results.** `Theorems/FuelStability.lean` ends after `stepBody_pushBytes`; none of the FUEL-STAB/FUEL-CAN theorems or pins exist, and the §B proof is malformed. Complete the module or remove the claims from the module/release notes.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `ScriptExact`/`Expand` totality claims are tautologies.
issue4_items.description: **`ScriptExact`/`Expand` totality claims are tautologies.** `Wallet/Miniscript/ScriptExact.lean:261` proves `∃ s, toScript ctx n = s`; `Wallet/Desc/Expand.lean:618,623` prove `f d p = f d p` and `∃ r, f d p = r`. Either remove or replace with substantive characterizations.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: P2SH/witness sigop counting is not Core's.
issue4_items.description: **P2SH/witness sigop counting is not Core's.** `AF/PDW29/PDW29Sigops.lean:176-178` uses flat-20 `legacySigOpCountScript`/`sigOpScan`, omitting push-only and accurate P2WSH handling. Reuse `accurateSigOpCount`/`countWitnessSigOps`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: open or partly addressed; confirm exact current source and acceptance evidence

issue4_items.title: `workOf`/`compactNegative` gate is wrong.
issue4_items.description: **`workOf`/`compactNegative` gate is wrong.** `AF/PDW24/PDW24.lean:89,44`: `compactNegative` tests the unshifted mantissa, and `workOf` adds a powLimit gate Core does not have. Align with `setCompactWord` and `GetBitsProof`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Assumevalid model omits Core gates.
issue4_items.description: **Assumevalid model omits Core gates.** `AF/PDW46/PDW46.lean:308,415`: missing assumevalid hash/ancestor/best-header/chainwork gates; the `h < a` boundary also excludes the assumevalid block's own height.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `min_pow_checked` model is too narrow.
issue4_items.description: **`min_pow_checked` model is too narrow.** `AF/PDW8/Blk122Cor.lean:138`: derives the flag from `nMinimumChainWork` alone; Core also uses near-tip work, candidate proof, and `GetAntiDoSWorkThreshold`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: BIP9 timeout/threshold order is wrong.
issue4_items.description: **BIP9 timeout/threshold order is wrong.** `Bip/B08/Bip141Defs.lean:238` and `Bip141Tests.lean:212` test timeout before threshold; Core checks the signal count first (`.lockedIn`, not `.failed`).
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Annex hash omits the CompactSize prefix.
issue4_items.description: **Annex hash omits the CompactSize prefix.** `AF/PDW77/PDW77.lean:83` and `AF/PDW41/TPR006.lean:43`: the key-path annex digest is raw SHA256; BIP341/Core hash `CompactSize(len) || annex`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: INV-077 witness-unexpected case is missing.
issue4_items.description: **INV-077 witness-unexpected case is missing.** `AF/PDW52/PDW52.lean:137`: `witnessUnexpected_nonWitness` assumes `flags.p2sh = false`, so it never covers the ordinary non-P2SH scriptPubKey under consensus flags.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: INV-043 op-count gate is BASE-only.
issue4_items.description: **INV-043 op-count gate is BASE-only.** `AF/PDW88/PDW88.lean:17`: the theorem fixes `ctx.sv = .base`; `stepBody` also counts in WITNESS_V0.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: SCR-051 is policy-conditional, not consensus.
issue4_items.description: **SCR-051 is policy-conditional, not consensus.** `AF/PDW98/PDW98.lean:161` and `AF/PDW95/PDW95b.lean:63` prove minimal operands only with `pol.minimalData = true`, while the row is marked `consensus: true`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: PDW94 stackop underflow list is incomplete.
issue4_items.description: **PDW94 stackop underflow list is incomplete.** `AF/PDW94/PDW94.lean:25`: the theorem covers a 19-opcode whitelist, not every consuming opcode claimed by the header.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Unexecuted IF omits the condition stack.
issue4_items.description: **Unexecuted IF omits the condition stack.** `AF/PDW85/PDW85b.lean:11`: conclusion only preserves `stack`/`alt`; the actual transition pushes `false` onto `vf`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Taproot commitment compares numerics, not bytes/length.
issue4_items.description: **Taproot commitment compares numerics, not bytes/length.** `AF/PDW56/PDW56.lean:112`: `bytesToNatBE` ignores length, so a 33-byte program with the same value is accepted; require `program.size = 32` and byte equality.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: SCR-149 is attached to the wrong witness branch.
issue4_items.description: **SCR-149 is attached to the wrong witness branch.** `AF/PDW19/PDW19.lean:78`: tags the witness-version ≥2 branch (SCR-151) as SCR-149; retag and cover the taproot leaf-version branch.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `taprootLane_consensus_pure` is vacuous.
issue4_items.description: **`taprootLane_consensus_pure` is vacuous.** `AF/PDW25/PDW25.lean:106`: the statement reduces to function congruence and does not express policy non-leakage.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `RawOK` does not assert on-curve.
issue4_items.description: **`RawOK` does not assert on-curve.** `AF/PDW42/PDW42.lean:75`: `liftX_on_curve_face` concludes only coordinate bounds; use `liftX_onCurve` or rename.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `PubKeyMatrix` rows cannot kernel-reduce.
issue4_items.description: **`PubKeyMatrix` rows cannot kernel-reduce.** `EcdsaDeep/PubKeyMatrix.lean:410,846,936,960`: `by decide` on `sqrtP`/`expM` paths is stuck; move to the R6/admit set or use a reducible square root.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `SmulCor` references a missing module.
issue4_items.description: **`SmulCor` references a missing module.** `EcdsaDeep/SmulCor.lean:36`: claims `SmulCorIF.lean`/`MulPIF`/`SmulIF`; the file does not exist. Add it or remove the claims.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: INV-119 MuHash is only Nat addition.
issue4_items.description: **INV-119 MuHash is only Nat addition.** `AF/PDW21/PDW21.lean:46`: `muhashSet` is a `Nat` sum, not MuHash3072 group arithmetic. Either implement the group or add INV-119 to `RESIDUALS.md`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: appears addressed: accepted additive residual now disclosed in source and RESIDUALS; confirm scope

issue4_items.title: Wallet obligations are false as stated.
issue4_items.description: **Wallet obligations are false as stated.** `Wallet/Obligations.lean:251` (empty `multi` expands successfully), `:554` (mixed height/time locks with `k = 1`), `:836` (unknown PSBT keys can survive finalization).
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Y12 block expectations are wrong.
issue4_items.description: **Y12 block expectations are wrong.** `Property/Y12/FoldProps.lean:767,794`: D12 expects `.ok` where the model returns `badTxnsBIP30`; E_227931 claims BIP30 rejection but only proves same-block duplicate coinbases are accepted.
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: Y15 witness-stack expectations are wrong.
issue4_items.description: **Y15 witness-stack expectations are wrong.** `Property/Y15/WitnessProps.lean:496,511`: `fe01000002` yields `.truncated` (not `.compactSizeTooLong`), and `0201aa00` is a valid two-item stack.
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: BIP144 output decode loses signedness.
issue4_items.description: **BIP144 output decode loses signedness.** `Bip/B10/Bip144.lean:110`: `rdVout` casts raw `Nat` to `Amount`; use `u64ToAmt` so negative int64 outputs decode as two's-complement negatives.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `PDW47` codeseparator fold ignores execution.
